name: HowHow Basic progress and continuation loop

target.workflowScript: const audit = await runs.run("progress-audit", { agent: "reviewer", task: "Inspect the current HowHow_Basic repository, roadmap/status artifacts, git history, active implementation evidence, and tests. Do not edit files. Estimate evidence-backed completion percentage by capability and identify the single highest-priority unblocked gap required for a genuinely working end-to-end autonomous research-to-LaTeX/arXiv package. Treat generated prose, mock output, and passing unit tests as insufficient without real product-path evidence. Return COMPLETE only when all declared acceptance criteria and a real end-to-end paper artifact are verified.", output: "scheduled/progress-audit.md", outputMode: "file-only" }); const work = await runs.run("continue-work", { agent: "worker", task: "Continue HowHow_Basic based on the independent progress audit at " + audit.output + ". You are the sole writer. If incomplete, implement one coherent highest-priority unblocked slice, add or improve tests, run focused validation, inspect user-visible outputs, update the canonical project status/roadmap truthfully, then review the diff, commit with a concise Conventional Commit, and push main to origin. If already COMPLETE, make no source changes and run the strongest affordable verification to confirm it. Never fabricate research evidence, citations, experimental results, novelty, scientific correctness, or publication readiness. Do not publish externally or submit to arXiv. Report changed files, commands and exit codes, commit/push state, completion percentage, remaining gaps, and user-only blockers.", acceptance: { level: "checked", evidence: ["changed-files", "tests-added", "commands-run", "validation-output", "residual-risks", "no-staged-files"] } }); return { audit: audit.output, work: work.output };
